title: Events & Workshops
description: Community spaces, workshops, and experiential sessions designed for emotional learning and connection.

ongoing.title: Internship Program — Deeper Dive
ongoing.summary: A Monday–Friday, in-person internship for psychology students and recent graduates at our Arumbakkam space — with flexible fees and group discounts.
ongoing.description:
Based on the multiple requests for more details, here is a deeper dive into our internship program!

The internship runs Monday to Friday, 1pm - 4pm at our organization's space in Arumbakkam, Chennai. Students who are full-time scholars pursuing UG/PG in psychology and related fields of humanities, as well as recent graduates, are eligible to apply.

The fee range varies based on the year and level of graduation — group discounts are also available!

ongoing.title: Therapists Talk — A Safe Space For and By Therapists
ongoing.summary: An online peer space for therapists every 2nd and 4th Saturday — bring your therapy experience, explore fit, then agree on a payment plan.
ongoing.description:
A safe space for and by therapists.

Join us every 2nd and 4th Saturday from 2:30-4:30pm online, and bring in everything and anything related to your therapy experience! Take the first two Saturdays to figure if the space is for you, and then we'll discuss a payment plan.

completed.title: Me, My (vulnerable)self and I
completed.summary: A workshop on embracing vulnerability as strength, facilitated by Srinidhi Vasudevan and Preethi.
completed.description:
Me, My (vulnerable)self and I was a pure success. Our workshop was full of insights and allowed ourselves to embrace our vulnerable selves.

Facilitated by Srinidhi Vasudevan and Preethi, the session created a safe space for participants to explore their vulnerability as a source of strength and self-awareness.
